verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Warehouse Connectors sync data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift and Postgres into Mixpanel, and a Mirror mode tracks warehouse changes via Snowflake Streams and Databricks Change Data Feed. That covers the warehouse-to-platform half of the story. The outbound half is only evidenced by the pull-based Raw Event Export API and a bare 'Data Pipelines' spec name, with no documented continuous push of events into the user's warehouse. Missing for 10: documented continuous event export to the customer's warehouse (Data Pipelines details, destinations, schedule or freshness), in-place querying of warehouse tables rather than ingestion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)

citations.quote: With Warehouse Connectors, you can sync data from data warehouses like Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres to Mixpanel.
Mixpanel will create and manage the necessary STREAM objects
To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API... This method is recommended for high volume exports.
